core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mohammed corresponds to the Arabic form محمد (Arabic root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad)). Its core sense is praised, commendable. Mohammed is Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad) 'praised, commendable', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); it is the name of the Prophet of Islam. The source gloss 'Praised' is consistent. Same name as mohammad and mohd.

faq.a: Mohammed is associated with the Arabic form محمد, whose core sense is praised, commendable.

faq.q: What is the origin of Mohammed?
faq.a: Mohammed is associated with Arabic. Mohammed is Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad) 'praised, commendable', from the root ح م د (ḥ-m-d); it is the name of the Prophet of Islam. The source gloss 'Praised' is consistent. Same name as mohammad and mohd.
Yes — the underlying form محمد is Arabic.
Mohammed can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mohammed should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Mohammed mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Mohammed is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، تعریف شدہ، ستودہ.

faq.q: What does Mohammed mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mohammed is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، ستوده، پسندیده.
A romanized syllable approximation is mo-ham-med. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mohammed?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mohammed, mohammed. Script forms are محمد, मुहम्मद.

faq.q: Is Mohammed a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
